denial_text:
Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 01/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880000
Amount claimed: Rs. 47,000

Sub: Repudiation of claim

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for laparoscopic cholecystectomy from 18/09/2026 to 22/09/2026. Policy inception 01/04/2020, renewed without break.

Reason for rejection: The patient has a history of gall bladder stones since 2021. The ailment is a pre-existing disease and the claim is not admissible under Clause 4.1 (Code- Excl01).

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 02/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880001
Amount claimed: Rs. 70,500

Sub: Repudiation and cancellation

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for treatment of diabetic foot infection. The insured has been continuously covered since 2019.

Reason for rejection: Non-disclosure of material fact. The insured did not disclose diabetes mellitus in the proposal form. The claim is repudiated and the policy is liable to be cancelled under Clause 9.1.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 03/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880002
Amount claimed: Rs. 94,000

Sub: Claim not admissible

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for cataract surgery, right eye. The policy was ported to us in 2025 from another insurer with three years of prior cover.

Reason for rejection: Cataract is subject to a 24 month waiting period under Code- Excl02. The policy with us is in its second year, so the waiting period has not been completed.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 04/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880003
Amount claimed: Rs. 117,500

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for knee replacement surgery following a road traffic accident on 03/08/2026. First policy year.

Reason for rejection: Joint replacement surgery is listed under the specified disease waiting period of 24 months (Code- Excl02).

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 05/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880004
Amount claimed: Rs. 141,000

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for hospitalisation for typhoid fever 12 days after the renewal date. The insured has been covered since 2022 without break.

Reason for rejection: Illness contracted within the first 30 days of the policy period is excluded under Code- Excl03.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 06/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880005
Amount claimed: Rs. 164,500

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for hospitalisation for dengue fever 10 days after the commencement of the first policy. No prior insurance.

Reason for rejection: Illness contracted within the first 30 days of the first policy is excluded under Code- Excl03.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 07/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880006
Amount claimed: Rs. 188,000

Sub: Partial settlement

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim partly settled. Insured stayed in a single private room above the eligible room rent limit.

Reason for rejection: Proportionate deduction of 40% has been applied to all hospital charges including pharmacy, consumables and implants as the room rent exceeded the eligible limit.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 08/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880007
Amount claimed: Rs. 211,500

Sub: Partial settlement

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim partly settled for a 6-day stay including 3 days in ICU.

Reason for rejection: Proportionate deduction applied on ICU charges and associated medical expenses since the room rent exceeded the eligible limit of 1% of sum insured.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 09/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880008
Amount claimed: Rs. 235,000

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for phacoemulsification cataract surgery. Admitted and discharged on the same day.

Reason for rejection: Hospitalisation was for less than 24 hours and therefore does not qualify as in-patient hospitalisation under the policy.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 10/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880009
Amount claimed: Rs. 258,500

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for chemotherapy cycles administered at the hospital day-care unit.

Reason for rejection: The treatment was taken on an outpatient (OPD) basis which is not covered under the policy.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 11/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880010
Amount claimed: Rs. 282,000

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for emergency hospitalisation after a cardiac event. The family intimated the insurer on the 6th day of admission.

Reason for rejection: Late intimation. The claim was intimated beyond 48 hours of emergency hospitalisation in breach of Clause 7.1.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 12/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880011
Amount claimed: Rs. 305,500

Sub: Claim closure

Dear Sir/Madam,

Reimbursement claim documents were submitted 45 days after discharge because the insured was caring for a hospitalised parent.

Reason for rejection: Documents not submitted within 30 days of discharge. The claim is closed for non-submission within the stipulated time.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 13/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880012
Amount claimed: Rs. 329,000

Sub: Partial settlement

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for 4 days of ICU stay advised by the treating cardiologist after chest pain with abnormal ECG.

Reason for rejection: ICU stay was not medically necessary; the patient could have been treated in a normal ward. ICU charges disallowed.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 14/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880013
Amount claimed: Rs. 352,500

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for admission with severe headache during which MRI revealed a brain tumour, followed by surgery in the same admission.

Reason for rejection: The admission was primarily for investigation and evaluation and is excluded under Code- Excl04.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 15/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880014
Amount claimed: Rs. 376,000

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for skin grafting following burns sustained in a kitchen fire accident.

Reason for rejection: Plastic surgery is excluded under Code- Excl08 of the policy.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 16/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880015
Amount claimed: Rs. 399,500

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for inguinal hernia repair. The insured ported to us 8 months ago after 4 years of continuous cover with another insurer.

Reason for rejection: Hernia is subject to a 24 month waiting period under Code- Excl02, which has not been completed.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 17/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880016
Amount claimed: Rs. 423,000

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for treatment of pneumonia.

Reason for rejection: The claim is not payable as per policy terms and conditions.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 18/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880017
Amount claimed: Rs. 446,500

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for treatment of hypertensive heart disease. Hypertension was declared at proposal. Policy inception 01/05/2022.

Reason for rejection: Hypertension is a declared pre-existing disease and treatment of its complications is excluded under Code- Excl01.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 19/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880018
Amount claimed: Rs. 470,000

Sub: Partial settlement

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim partly settled after a deluxe-room stay for appendectomy.

Reason for rejection: Consumables and medical devices have been reduced in the proportion of eligible room rent to actual room rent.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager

Suraksha General Insurance Ltd.
Claims Department

Date: 20/10/2026

Claim No: SGI/HC/2026/880019
Amount claimed: Rs. 493,500

Sub: Claim rejection

Dear Sir/Madam,

Claim for kidney stone removal (lithotripsy) in the 10th month of the first policy. No prior insurance. Not an accident.

Reason for rejection: Kidney stones are subject to a 24 month specified disease waiting period under Code- Excl02.

Yours faithfully,
Claims Manager
